comparison: Exact result and standard-output strings on success; rejection only on expected errors.

rows.name: cache-expr-variable
rows.source: set x 1; set out {}; foreach x {1 2 3} {lappend out [expr {$x+3}]}; set out

rows.name: cache-dynamic-command
rows.source: proc p {} {return old}; set code p; set out [eval $code]; proc p {} {return new}; list $out [eval $code]

rows.name: cache-rename-command
rows.source: proc p {} {return old}; set code p; eval $code; rename p q; proc p {} {return new}; list [eval $code] [q]

rows.name: cache-namespace-context
rows.source: namespace eval a {variable x 1; proc p {} {variable x; incr x}}; namespace eval b {variable x 5; proc p {} {variable x; incr x}}; set code {p}; list [namespace eval a $code] [namespace eval b $code] [namespace eval a $code]

rows.name: cache-recursive-mutate
rows.source: proc p {n} {global x; incr x; if {$n>0} {p [expr {$n-1}]}; return $x}; set x 0; list [p 4] [p 2]

rows.name: cache-parse-error-repeat
rows.source: set code "incr x; set y \{"; set x 0; list [catch {eval $code}] [catch {eval $code}] $x

rows.name: cache-early-return-invalid
rows.source: set code "return yes; set y \{"; list [catch {eval $code} result] $result [catch {eval $code} result] $result

rows.name: cache-lazy-variable-change
rows.source: set x 0; set out {}; foreach flag {0 1 0 1} {lappend out [expr {$flag && [incr x]}]}; list $out $x

rows.name: cache-command-replacement
rows.source: set code {set x 3}; eval $code; proc set args {return changed}; eval $code

rows.name: cache-list-copy
rows.source: set xs {}; for {set i 0} {$i<5} {incr i} {lappend xs $i}; set copy $xs; lappend xs X; list $copy $xs

rows.name: cache-list-alias
rows.source: set xs {}; upvar #0 xs ys; for {set i 0} {$i<5} {incr i} {lappend ys $i}; list $xs $ys

rows.name: cache-list-alias-unset
rows.source: set xs {}; upvar #0 xs ys; foreach i {1 2} {lappend ys $i}; unset xs; lappend ys 3; list $xs $ys

rows.name: cache-list-self
rows.source: set xs {a}; foreach i {1 2} {lappend xs $xs}; set xs

rows.name: cache-list-to-dict
rows.source: set x {}; foreach item {a 1 b 2} {lappend x $item}; dict incr x a; list $x [dict get $x b]

rows.name: cache-dict-to-list
rows.source: dict set x a 1; foreach item {b 2} {lappend x $item}; set x

rows.name: cache-list-set-invalidate
rows.source: set x {}; foreach i {1 2} {lappend x $i}; set x {new}; foreach i {3 4} {lappend x $i}; set x

rows.name: cache-dict-copy
rows.source: set d {}; foreach i {a b c} {dict set d $i $i}; set copy $d; dict set d a changed; list $copy $d
rows.result: {a a b b c c} {a changed b b c c}

actual.result: {a a b b c c} {a changed b b c c}

rows.name: cache-dict-alias
rows.source: set d {}; upvar #0 d e; foreach i {a b c} {dict set e $i $i}; list $d $e
rows.result: {a a b b c c} {a a b b c c}

actual.result: {a a b b c c} {a a b b c c}

rows.name: cache-dict-replace
rows.source: set d {}; foreach i {a b c} {dict set d $i $i}; set d {x 2}; dict incr d x; set d

rows.name: cache-dict-self
rows.source: set d {}; dict set d x 1; foreach i {y z} {dict set d $i $d}; set d

rows.name: cache-dict-nested-fallback
rows.source: set d {}; foreach i {a b c} {dict set d $i 1}; dict set d a x 2; dict set d b 3; set d
rows.result: missing value to go with key

rows.name: cache-dict-with-cache
rows.source: set d {}; foreach i {a b c} {dict set d $i 1}; dict with d {incr a; unset b}; dict incr d c; set d

rows.name: cache-dict-update-error
rows.source: set d {}; foreach i {a b c} {dict set d $i 1}; catch {dict update d a x {incr x; error bad}}; dict set d z 3; set d

rows.name: cache-array-list
rows.source: array set a {}; foreach i {1 2 3} {lappend a(x) $i}; set a(x)

rows.name: cache-array-dict
rows.source: array set a {}; foreach i {a b c} {dict set a(x) $i 1}; dict incr a(x) a; set a(x)

rows.name: cache-list-array-collision
rows.source: foreach i {1 2} {lappend x $i}; array set x {}
rows.result: can't array set "x": variable isn't array

rows.name: cache-dict-array-collision
rows.source: foreach i {a b} {dict set x $i 1}; set x(0) 4

rows.name: cache-loop-if-result
rows.source: set xs {}; foreach x {0 1 2} {if {$x>0} {lappend xs $x}}; set xs

rows.name: cache-catch-result
rows.source: set xs {}; foreach x {1 2} {lappend xs $x}; list [catch {lappend xs 3} result] $result $xs

rows.name: cache-proc-result
rows.source: proc p {} {set xs {}; foreach x {1 2} {lappend xs $x}; lappend xs 3}; p

rows.name: cache-empty-namespace
rows.source: namespace eval n {variable x 3; namespace eval {} {namespace current}}
rows.result: can't create namespace "": only global namespace can have empty name

rows.name: cache-dict-duplicates
rows.source: set d {a 1 b 2 a 3}; dict append d a; set d

rows.name: cache-list-whitespace
rows.source: set x { a   b }; foreach item {c d} {lappend x $item}; set x

rows.name: cache-dict-zero-append
rows.source: set d { a 1   b 2 }; dict append d a; set d

rows.name: cache-increment-prefix
rows.source: set x 010; for {set i 0} {$i<3} {incr i} {incr x}; set x

rows.name: cache-dynamic-script-eviction
rows.source: set out 0; for {set i 0} {$i<300} {incr i} {eval [list set x $i]; incr out}; list $x $out
